English.Keywords: duplicate finder, duplicate photos, duplicate videos, duplicate files, similar images, free, windows
English.Char_Desc_45: Finds duplicate files, photos and videos
English.Char_Desc_80: Finds exact copies and look-alike photos, videos and documents, then moves them.
English.Char_Desc_250: Pick a folder and find exact copies, documents with the same words, or photos and videos that look the same even after resizing or re-encoding. Copies are moved to a review folder, never deleted, and Undo puts them back.
English.Char_Desc_450: Pick a folder and find exact copies, documents with the same words, or photos and videos that look the same even after resizing or re-encoding. Copies are moved to a review folder, never deleted, and Undo puts them back. Free. Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit; nothing else to install.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
Duplicate File Finder looks in a folder for exact copies of any kind of file, Word, PDF, RTF, OpenDocument and text files with the same words, photos that look the same even after being resized or re-saved, and videos that look the same even after being re-encoded, resized, given black bars or shortened at the start or end. Click 1. Choose folder, pick what to look for, then 3. Scan. The list shows what will be moved and the better copy that stays put, with picture or text previews; take any row off the list before moving. 4. Move all listed copies moves them into a Duplicates_To_Review folder. Nothing is ever deleted, every move is logged, and Undo last move puts them back. Re-scans are faster because fingerprints are remembered.
Before you install: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. The installer is not code-signed (a signing certificate is a paid yearly service), so Windows may show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box: click More info, then Run anyway. A few antivirus programs wrongly flag new unsigned programs; you can check the download against the SHA-256 fingerprint on its release page. No administrator password is needed.

Permissions.Distribution_Permissions: Duplicate File Finder is free to use and share. Download sites may list it and offer the unchanged Setup.exe, or link to the download page.
Permissions.EULA: Duplicate File Finder is free and comes with no warranty. Use it at your own risk. The free parts it is built from keep their own licenses, listed in the licenses folder it installs.
